chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him), in which he taught the people the invocation of divine blessings upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).
[And in it is an explanation of the attributes of God, exalted He is, and the attribute of the Prophet, and supplication for him.]

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: Invocation of divine blessing (specifically upon the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali teach people regarding Salat upon the Prophet in his sermons?
ai.summary: In this sermon from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the theological and spiritual dimensions of sending blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad, linking divine attributes with the Prophet's unique status. This teaching serves as a practical guide for the community to deepen their connection to the Prophet through structured supplication, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the intercessory role and spiritual excellence of the Ahl al-Bayt.
